basis: Source inventory; not live-provider or installed-engine certification

features.verified_scope: Local/cloud flows, authoritative session status, queued submissions and reconnect handling exist.
features.gap_or_next_step: Run a single behavioral contract across local, SSH and cloud; expose cancellation/queued/blocked states consistently.
features.acceptance: Disconnect mid-stream, change session, reconnect, cancel and resend: no duplicate turn, stale status or lost draft.

features.verified_scope: Attachment-bearing work waits for a normal multimodal turn; direct steering remains text-only.
features.gap_or_next_step: Make “queued for next turn” explicit; do not pretend queued media was already seen.
features.acceptance: Busy-session image + identical text submissions preserve separate identities and reach the intended turn.

features.verified_scope: Composer checks image capabilities; media format/budget checks exist; unresolved capabilities can fail visibly at runtime.
features.gap_or_next_step: Add an unknown/verified/unsupported readiness badge and a safe optional synthetic image test for an exact provider/model.
features.acceptance: Known vision, non-vision, unknown metadata, corrupt image, oversized image and model-switch cases. No silent stripping.

features.verified_scope: Provider catalog supports custom configurations, model preservation and modality/reasoning metadata.
features.gap_or_next_step: Catalog presence is not endpoint capability proof; retain exact model identity and never silently substitute after partial discovery.
features.acceptance: Provider-specific multimodal/tool/reasoning contract matrix and explicit reauthorization/fallback behavior.

features.verified_scope: Streaming or stop-to-transcribe models are selected independently from chat.
features.gap_or_next_step: Do not equate voice dictation with full real-time voice conversation; test microphone privacy and failed upload recovery.
features.acceptance: Permission denied, stop/cancel, device switch, offline provider, long recording and restart tests.

features.verified_scope: Local content search has deadlines; metadata fallback and cloud metadata search exist.
features.gap_or_next_step: Expose content-index unavailable versus no result; test fallback coverage beyond recent local sessions.
features.acceptance: Older session, isolated workspace, cloud-only hit, offline index and query cancellation cases.

features.verified_scope: Asynchronous streaming discovery includes approved project configuration directories, cancellation and independent traversal budgets.
features.gap_or_next_step: An incomplete search is explicitly marked; filesystem I/O already in progress may outlast the elapsed-time budget.
features.acceptance: Find .github/.agents configuration, remain responsive on large no-match trees, support cancellation.

features.verified_scope: Sidebar has project grouping, schedules and dedicated Functions/Engineering/Customize paths.
features.gap_or_next_step: Add persistent project overview with goals, instructions, artifacts, environments and runs; keep existing paths reachable.
features.acceptance: Users can identify current project/environment/model/profile from every workspace and recover selection after restart.

features.verified_scope: Exact-revision worktrees, dirty/conflict checks, Apply/Create Branch/Open PR/Keep/Discard are documented.
features.gap_or_next_step: Protect these behaviors during navigation redesign; make committed/uncommitted work and ownership visible.
features.acceptance: Dirty checkout, cherry-pick conflict, retained worktree deletion and repeated cleanup fixtures.

features.verified_scope: Tracked/untracked review and exact-head/current-base installer evidence checks exist.
features.gap_or_next_step: Give users a coherent plan → diff → tests → PR → CI → merge journey; never promote an unknown CI state.
features.acceptance: Branch changes during review, stale base, cancelled runs, duplicate contexts and artifact expiry block approval.

features.verified_scope: Team task controls and isolated-writer worktrees are documented.
features.gap_or_next_step: Use one task ownership/readiness model and aggregate budgets; add multi-writer conflict/failure drills.
features.acceptance: Parent cancellation, child retry, stale roster, independent outputs, bounded concurrency and least-privilege inheritance.

features.verified_scope: Owner-scoped process lifecycle, stdin/resize/PTY and PID start-token recovery are documented.
features.gap_or_next_step: Restored processes cannot promise recovered stdin/terminal state; show that distinction prominently.
features.acceptance: Foreground/background, detached owner loss, exact PID identity, secret output redaction and Windows ConPTY.

features.verified_scope: Atomic task-state, transition validation, bounded history and checkpoint reconciliation exist.
features.gap_or_next_step: Automatic validation is restricted to eligible local approval modes; do not claim all remote tasks auto-verify.
features.acceptance: Crash between step completion and verification, stale plan update, rollback and remote declared-only commands.

features.verified_scope: Draft recovery controls and session-owned persisted state are present.
features.gap_or_next_step: Add power-loss/large-history/operator-recovery suites; distinguish conversation restore from process replay.
features.acceptance: Unsent draft survives crash; explicit opt-in recovery; no duplicated write effects on reconnect.

features.status: Implemented tool policy; not general OS containment
features.verified_scope: Profiles enforce registered tools; arbitrary allowed shell keeps the parent process OS access.
features.gap_or_next_step: Introduce a separate sandbox tier; retain clearly labeled Full Access for trusted work.
features.acceptance: Restrict unapproved reads/network at OS boundary for sandboxed tasks; prove no silent fallback.

features.verified_scope: Provider settings serialize credential fields to JSON with owner-only POSIX modes; Windows chmod is not ACL enforcement.
features.gap_or_next_step: Store secrets in OS vaults and keep references in settings; avoid plaintext exports and support safe migration.
features.acceptance: Vault unavailable fails visibly; legacy migration is recoverable; fixture secrets absent from config/log/export.

features.verified_scope: Dedicated desktop transport authentication and boundary tests are documented.
features.gap_or_next_step: Retain endpoint token rotation/origin/identity checks across Hub upgrades and shared-client recovery.
features.acceptance: Expired token, wrong origin, replaced Hub, malformed frame, pending-call limit and cancellation tests.

features.verified_scope: MCP settings, connection/OAuth surfaces and provider integration modules exist.
features.gap_or_next_step: Per-connector capability/authorization health and revocation tests; registry presence must not imply a usable service.
features.acceptance: Revoked/expired token, substituted server, tool schema drift, reconnect and read/write permission tests.

features.status: Implemented; provenance assurance not established by this audit
features.verified_scope: Install/uninstall flows, official plugin paths and partial-install detection exist.
features.gap_or_next_step: Audit dependency provenance, install effects, capability grants and rollback before a trusted-extension maturity label.
features.acceptance: Tampered/unpinned source, interrupted install, privilege expansion and uninstall boundary fixtures.

features.verified_scope: Six integrity-checked instruction-only investigation skills ship.
features.gap_or_next_step: Add tested engineering and document workflows; do not confuse instructions with an executable engine or guaranteed expertise.
features.acceptance: Skill discovery, exact version, dependency readiness, disabled skill and known-answer success/failure cases.

features.verified_scope: Permanent instructions and plugin/rule customization exist.
features.gap_or_next_step: Separate global/project/task instructions, show precedence and use untrusted-context boundaries; add conflicts/size tests.
features.acceptance: Project change updates effective instructions without leaking another project’s context.

features.verified_scope: Custom instructions, session search, saved investigation notebooks and project-to-Notion memory are distinct systems.
features.gap_or_next_step: Define an explicit project knowledge index, consent, source citations, stale-source handling and forget/export UX.
features.acceptance: Deletion removes derived index entries; revoked source is unreadable; stale claims are labeled. Not a claim that all memory code is absent.

features.status: Implemented; exact external tool availability required
features.verified_scope: Read-only evidence packaging, official Notion MCP isolation, iterative evidence requests and bounded resume are documented.
features.gap_or_next_step: Keep this as a connector-backed knowledge workflow—not a clone of Notion’s databases/collaborative editor.
features.acceptance: Missing Agent discovery/messaging blocks honestly; redacted evidence transfer and resumed session identity are checked.

features.verified_scope: Durable cron runner uses leases, bounded concurrency and sleep/cancel handling.
features.gap_or_next_step: Replace synchronous timezone minute scanning; display next runs/timezone, offline behavior and overlap/retry semantics.
features.acceptance: DST gap/fold, sparse/impossible expressions, sleep/wake, cancellation and duplicate-leasing tests.

features.verified_scope: Agenda UI and Hub todo kind are disabled; Channels is hidden from navigation while its route remains.
features.gap_or_next_step: Make status and reason discoverable; do not simply flip flags without complete UX and lifecycle acceptance.
features.acceptance: Both Hub/UI agree on capability; no ghost commands, unreachable tasks or lost persisted data.

features.verified_scope: Background-only completion/approval notification preferences and permission handling exist.
features.gap_or_next_step: A unified activity inbox should collect approvals, failures, scheduled results and agent handoffs.
features.acceptance: Denied OS permission, stale session click, quiet mode and multi-window focus behavior.

features.verified_scope: Cloud sessions are account/rollout gated and explicitly preview-labeled.
features.gap_or_next_step: Do not claim cross-device parity; verify data residency, reconnect, local-folder reachability and permission scope.
features.acceptance: Account switch, cancelled provisioning, disconnected desktop, artifact persistence and cross-device continuation.

features.verified_scope: Remote commands, environment binding and strict host-key checking exist.
features.gap_or_next_step: Show where each tool/file/terminal executes; expose reconnect and remote readiness without weakening host-key trust.
features.acceptance: Wrong host key, absent remote runtime, stale host, same session ID in two environments and owner-safe deletion.

features.verified_scope: Structured WebView2 browser supports navigation/inspection/actions; user-driven auth and password rejection are documented.
features.gap_or_next_step: Provide clear auth handoff and limitations; robust consequence approval needs more than text labels.
features.acceptance: Authenticated state handoff, lost target, protected inputs, ambiguous consequence and browser expiry.

features.verified_scope: Opt-in exact-application targeting, owner leases, action budgets and Stop/Take Over are documented.
features.gap_or_next_step: Keep browser/API-first routing and exact process identity; do not represent it as unrestricted safe desktop autonomy.
features.acceptance: Focus theft, process replacement, protected surface, lease expiry, agent cancellation and takeover.

features.verified_scope: Native preview is bounded text/image/PDF; larger/other formats become metadata and external-open.
features.gap_or_next_step: Add paged safe previews and first-class DOCX/XLSX/PPTX workflows if general-purpose document work is a target.
features.acceptance: Large PDFs, malicious active content, Office files, edit/export/reopen round trip; external applications are not embedded previews.

features.verified_scope: Static parser, closed-inventory bindings, saved provenance, limited source maps and explicit runtime observations exist.
features.gap_or_next_step: Runtime source-map reconciliation and broader semantic coverage remain partial; support manifests must describe supported syntax.
features.acceptance: Bundlers, dynamic imports, closures, source maps and unresolved-edge negative fixtures.

features.verified_scope: Managed metadata/selected IL, native analysis projects and external engine readiness exist.
features.gap_or_next_step: General native rewriting, complete .NET recovery and universal cross-language analysis are not established.
features.acceptance: Per-format/ISA/generics/exception fixtures; distinguish inferred source from exact bytes and licensed decompiler results.

features.verified_scope: Static APK/DEX/resource evidence and separately authorized candidate/build/sign/verify/device operations are documented.
features.gap_or_next_step: Do not promise unattended install-to-verification or universal APK reconstruction; typed receipts and device/key scope are essential.
features.acceptance: Multidex, malformed resource, package/signature mismatch, authorized device, failure recovery and original preservation.

features.verified_scope: Integrity-checked packs, eleven owned engine fixtures, separate angr runtime and idle apply/rollback exist.
features.gap_or_next_step: Pack retention/storage policy is unfinished; IDA license, devices and remote isolation remain external prerequisites.
features.acceptance: Disk pressure, corrupt pack, busy backend, revoked license, device identity and rollback with active shared Hub.

features.verified_scope: Approved isolation/Inspector/device observation and signed-worker evidence workflows are documented.
features.gap_or_next_step: No generic “execute anything safely” guarantee; remote signatures are not hardware attestation or proof of remote teardown.
features.acceptance: Exact binary/process/device identity, time budget, cancellation, failed isolation and worker loss.

features.verified_scope: Hash-bound candidates, saved graph witnesses, audit outcomes and separate approvals exist.
features.gap_or_next_step: Whole-program taint/alias/semantic correctness and general refactoring are not provided by a relationship graph.
features.acceptance: Negative/unresolved paths, stale evidence, overlapping edits, signature/checksum implications and failed candidate retention.

features.status: Implemented control surface; quality needs live measurement
features.verified_scope: Mission/worktree/review/model-route controls are present.
features.gap_or_next_step: Tie every mission result to the same task, diff, tests and CI authorities; do not infer real-model competence from scripted transport.
features.acceptance: Known-answer coding/review tasks, controlled model comparison, failed repairs and reproducible run identity.

features.verified_scope: Economy/Balanced/Deep are per owning process; baseline status remains required.
features.gap_or_next_step: Measure startup, event-loop delay, memory, large history, command latency and multi-agent contention before optimization claims.
features.acceptance: Cold/warm controlled before/after corpus; no removed acceptance assertions or machine-wide-quota claims.

features.status: Build/release verification implemented; desktop auto-update disabled
features.verified_scope: Exact-head/base/merge receipts; private unsigned artifact-only distribution; desktop updater endpoints empty.
features.gap_or_next_step: Safe private update/rollback is a separate project; retain manual distribution until owner signing/migration acceptance exists.
features.acceptance: Bad signature/hash, incompatible schema, downgrade, interrupted activation and rollback without losing projects.

features.status: Some tests; comprehensive coverage not established
features.verified_scope: Semantic UI elements, notification permissions and targeted interaction tests exist.
features.gap_or_next_step: Keyboard/screen-reader/high-contrast/zoom/localization validation must span the whole app; no complete accessibility audit was performed.
features.acceptance: Windows Narrator + keyboard-only journeys, 200% zoom, focus restoration and long live-region content.
